<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sn_adv_appr_mgmt_approval_rule"><sn_adv_appr_mgmt_approval_rule action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><active>true</active><advanced>true</advanced><approval_chain display_value="Sales Management">86a6fdcc2b0fc7104deaf02ac891bfcd</approval_chain><approval_criteria>anyone</approval_criteria><approval_trigger_condition display_value="Discount Tier 3 (30%+)">e7afb44c2b83c7104deaf02ac891bfc0</approval_trigger_condition><approver_type>user</approver_type><auto_escalate>false</auto_escalate><description>Sales GM Discount Approval</description><dynamic_approver/><dynamic_escalated_assignee/><entity_table>sn_quote_mgmt_core_quote</entity_table><escalated_assignee/><escalation_schedule display_value="Approval Escalation SLA">d7be3207b5d73a90f8778a808e889a9f</escalation_schedule><escalation_type>user</escalation_type><expected_days_to_complete/><name>Sales GM Discount Approval</name><order>30</order><scripted_approver><![CDATA[(function eval(headerGr, ruleGr) {
    /* Resolve the account's primary sales territory, walk up the territory
     * hierarchy skipping the first two levels that have an active, primary
     * Territory Manager (Sales Manager's level, then Sales VP's level),
     * and route to the THIRD level's active, primary Territory Manager -
     * one level above the Sales VP - as the Sales GM approver.
     */
    var territorySysId = null;
    var acctSysId = headerGr.getValue('account');
    if (acctSysId) {
        var acctGr = new GlideRecord('customer_account');
        if (acctGr.get(acctSysId)) {
            territorySysId = acctGr.getValue('primary_sales_territory');
        }
    }

    var managerSysId = null;
    var levelsPassed = 0;
    var today = new GlideDate();
    var guard = 0;

    while (territorySysId && !managerSysId && guard < 10) {
        var terrGr = new GlideRecord('sn_tp_territory');
        var parentTerritorySysId = terrGr.get(territorySysId) ? terrGr.getValue('parent') : null;

        var mgrGr = new GlideRecord('sn_tp_territory_manager');
        mgrGr.addQuery('territory', territorySysId);
        mgrGr.addQuery('manager_type', 'territory_manager');
        mgrGr.addQuery('primary', true);
        mgrGr.addQuery('from', '<=', today);
        mgrGr.addQuery('to', '>=', today);
        mgrGr.query();

        if (mgrGr.next()) {
            if (levelsPassed < 2) {
                // Level 0 = Sales Manager, Level 1 = Sales VP - skip both for GM
                levelsPassed++;
            } else {
                managerSysId = mgrGr.getValue('manager');
            }
        }

        territorySysId = parentTerritorySysId;
        guard++;
    }

    answer = managerSysId ? [managerSysId] : [];
})(headerGr, ruleGr);]]></scripted_approver><sys_class_name>sn_adv_appr_mgmt_approval_rule</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>admin</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-08-27 00:57:17</sys_created_on><sys_id>1d26358c2b4bc7104deaf02ac891bf76</sys_id><sys_mod_count>6</sys_mod_count><sys_name>Sales GM Discount Approval</sys_name><sys_package display_value="Global" source="global">global</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Global">global</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sn_adv_appr_mgmt_approval_rule_1d26358c2b4bc7104deaf02ac891bf76</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>admin</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-09-03 00:42:29</sys_updated_on></sn_adv_appr_mgmt_approval_rule></record_update>

     */
    var territorySysId = null;
    var acctSysId = headerGr.getValue('account');

        if (acctGr.get(acctSysId)) {

        }

    var managerSysId = null;
    var today = new GlideDate();

    while (territorySysId && !managerSysId && guard < 10) {

        mgrGr.addQuery('from', '<=', today);

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sn_adv_appr_mgmt_approval_rule"><sn_adv_appr_mgmt_approval_rule action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><active>true</active><advanced>true</advanced><approval_chain display_value="Sales Management">86a6fdcc2b0fc7104deaf02ac891bfcd</approval_chain><approval_criteria>anyone</approval_criteria><approval_trigger_condition display_value="Discount Tier 2 (20%+)">408ff48c2b83c7104deaf02ac891bf0e</approval_trigger_condition><approver_type>user</approver_type><auto_escalate>false</auto_escalate><description>Sales VP Discount Approval</description><dynamic_approver/><dynamic_escalated_assignee/><entity_table>sn_quote_mgmt_core_quote</entity_table><escalated_assignee/><escalation_schedule display_value="Approval Escalation SLA">d7be3207b5d73a90f8778a808e889a9f</escalation_schedule><escalation_type>user</escalation_type><expected_days_to_complete/><name>Sales VP Discount Approval</name><order>20</order><scripted_approver><![CDATA[(function eval(headerGr, ruleGr) {
    /* Resolve the account's primary sales territory, walk up until the first
     * level with an active, primary Territory Manager is found (this is the
     * Sales Manager's level), then continue walking up to find the NEXT
     * level's active, primary Territory Manager - one level above the
     * Sales Manager in the territory hierarchy - and route to them.
     */
    var territorySysId = null;
    var acctSysId = headerGr.getValue('account');
    if (acctSysId) {
        var acctGr = new GlideRecord('customer_account');
        if (acctGr.get(acctSysId)) {
            territorySysId = acctGr.getValue('primary_sales_territory');
        }
    }

    var managerSysId = null;
    var passedSalesManagerLevel = false;
    var today = new GlideDate();
    var guard = 0;

    while (territorySysId && !managerSysId && guard < 10) {
        var terrGr = new GlideRecord('sn_tp_territory');
        var parentTerritorySysId = terrGr.get(territorySysId) ? terrGr.getValue('parent') : null;

        var mgrGr = new GlideRecord('sn_tp_territory_manager');
        mgrGr.addQuery('territory', territorySysId);
        mgrGr.addQuery('manager_type', 'territory_manager');
        mgrGr.addQuery('primary', true);
        mgrGr.addQuery('from', '<=', today);
        mgrGr.addQuery('to', '>=', today);
        mgrGr.query();

        if (mgrGr.next()) {
            if (!passedSalesManagerLevel) {
                // This is the Sales Manager's level - go one level higher for the VP
                passedSalesManagerLevel = true;
            } else {
                managerSysId = mgrGr.getValue('manager');
            }
        }

        territorySysId = parentTerritorySysId;
        guard++;

    /* Resolve the account's primary sales territory, then walk up the
     * territory hierarchy (parent) until a level with an active,
     * primary Territory Manager is found. Route the approval to them.
     */
    var territorySysId = null;
    var acctSysId = headerGr.getValue('account');
    if (acctSysId) {
        var acctGr = new GlideRecord('customer_account');
        if (acctGr.get(acctSysId)) {
            territorySysId = acctGr.getValue('primary_sales_territory');
        }
    }

    var managerSysId = null;
    var today = new GlideDate();
    var guard = 0;

    while (territorySysId && !managerSysId && guard < 10) {
        var mgrGr = new GlideRecord('sn_tp_territory_manager');
        mgrGr.addQuery('territory', territorySysId);
        mgrGr.addQuery('manager_type', 'territory_manager');
        mgrGr.addQuery('primary', true);
        mgrGr.addQuery('from', '<=', today);
        mgrGr.addQuery('to', '>=', today);
        mgrGr.query();

        if (mgrGr.next()) {
            managerSysId = mgrGr.getValue('manager');
        } else {
            var terrGr = new GlideRecord('sn_tp_territory');
            territorySysId = terrGr.get(territorySysId) ? terrGr.getValue('parent') : null;
        }
        guard++;
    }

    answer = managerSysId ? [managerSysId] : [];
})(headerGr, ruleGr);]]></scripted_approver><sys_class_name>sn_adv_appr_mgmt_approval_rule</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>admin</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-08-26 21:00:36</sys_created_on><sys_id>efff78cc2b83c7104deaf02ac891bfa5</sys_id><sys_mod_count>7</sys_mod_count><sys_name>Sales Manager Discount Approval</sys_name><sys_package display_value="Global" source="global">global</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Global">global</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sn_adv_appr_mgmt_approval_rule_efff78cc2b83c7104deaf02ac891bfa5</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>admin</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-09-02 18:41:21</sys_updated_on></sn_adv_appr_mgmt_approval_rule></record_update>

    var stepGr = new GlideRecord('sn_adv_appr_mgmt_approval_step');
    stepGr.addQuery('approval_trigger_condition', conditionGr.getUniqueValue());
    stepGr.addQuery('stateIN', '2,3'); // approved or rejected
    stepGr.addQuery('auto_approved', false);
    stepGr.orderByDesc('sys_created_on');
    stepGr.setLimit(1);
    stepGr.query();

    if (!stepGr.next()) {
        answer = false; // no prior decision to compare against
        return;
    }

    var snapshot = JSON.parse(stepGr.getValue('field_snapshot') || '{}');
    var prevDiscount = parseFloat(snapshot.discount_percentage);
    var currDiscount = parseFloat(headerGr.getValue('discount_percentage'));

    if (isNaN(prevDiscount) || isNaN(currDiscount) || prevDiscount === 0) {
        answer = false;
        return;
    }

    answer = ((currDiscount - prevDiscount) / prevDiscount) <= 0.05;
})(headerGr, conditionGr);]]></scripted_smart_condition><smart_reapproval>true</smart_reapproval><smart_reapproval_condition/><sys_class_name>sn_adv_appr_mgmt_approval_trigger_condition</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>admin</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-08-26 20:58:30</sys_created_on><sys_id>408ff48c2b83c7104deaf02ac891bf0e</sys_id><sys_mod_count>2</sys_mod_count><sys_name>Discount Tier 2 (20%+)</sys_name><sys_package display_value="Global" source="global">global</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Global">global</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sn_adv_appr_mgmt_approval_trigger_condition_408ff48c2b83c7104deaf02ac891bf0e</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>admin</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-09-03 02:49:38</sys_updated_on></sn_adv_appr_mgmt_approval_trigger_condition></record_update>
